CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListSetAt

Returns a copy of a list with the element at the given position replaced by a new value. All the delimiters stay exactly where they were.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListSetAt(list, position, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to change.
position
The index of the element to replace, from 1 to ListLen(list).
value
The new element.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The new list.

Usage

A position less than 1 or greater than the number of elements causes an error. Because the original delimiters are kept, ListSetAt works nicely on lists with mixed delimiters, such as a date or a sentence.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Party = "12/31/1999">
<CFSET Sentence = "I love KoldFusion; it is fast, fun and friendly">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Before</TH><TH>After</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>#Party#</TD><TD>#ListSetAt(Party, 3, "2000", "/")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>#Sentence#</TD><TD>#ListSetAt(Sentence, 6, "free", " ,;")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListGetAt, ListInsertAt, ListDeleteAt, ArraySet
